movie.title: My Dead Summer
movie.overview: A wanna-be blogger embarks on a wild summer road trip as a psychedelic concert-goer along with his dog, step-dad, and a small film crew.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: An aspiring blogger hits the open road with his dog, stepdad, and a small film crew for a wild summer spent chasing psychedelic concerts and self-discovery.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Eager to break out of his shell and create content that matters, a wanna-be blogger sets out on an unpredictable summer road trip. Accompanied by his loyal dog, an eccentric stepdad, and a skeleton film crew, he dives headfirst into the chaotic world of psychedelic concert-goers. Along the way, the crew encounters bizarre personalities, unexpected delays, and moments of genuine bonding. Ultimately, the chaotic journey forces everyone involved to reevaluate their relationships and what they truly want out of life.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Determined to make a name for himself in the digital world, an ambitious young blogger conceives what he believes to be his ultimate passion project: a summer-long documentary following the colorful subculture of psychedelic concert-goers. To turn his vision into reality, he rounds up an unlikely traveling party consisting of his beloved dog, his well-meaning but often overbearing stepdad, and a small, ragtag film crew. As they pile into a cramped vehicle and embark on the open road, the initial excitement quickly gives way to the harsh realities of low-budget travel and clashing personalities. From vehicle breakdowns in the middle of nowhere to bizarre encounters with eccentric festival regulars, every leg of the journey tests the group's patience and resolve. The protagonist's stepdad frequently attempts to bond, sparking both comedic friction and heartfelt moments of vulnerability. Meanwhile, the film crew captures every high and low, transforming what was supposed to be a polished music docuseries into an intimate, chaotic slice-of-life disaster. As the summer draws to a close, the blogger begins to realize that the real story wasn't the music festivals, but the eccentric family dynamic that unfolded along the way. In the end, the misadventures on the road reshape his perspective on ambition, acceptance, and the true meaning of connection.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: My Dead Summer follows an ambitious aspiring blogger who sets out on an eccentric summer road trip to document the colorful, chaotic world of psychedelic concert-goers. joined by a quirky traveling party—including his loyal dog, his overenthusiastic stepdad, and a small, ragtag film crew—the journey quickly evolves into a unpredictable adventure packed with bizarre encounters, dynamic clashes, and unexpected self-discovery.

story_structure.climax: A major breakdown—either interpersonal or logistically catastrophic—occurs during a pivotal stop on the tour, forcing everyone to decide whether to push forward or call it quits.
story_structure.conflict: Clashing personalities, the unpredictable nature of living on the road, and the constant pressure to capture compelling content begin to strain relationships and disrupt the group's journey.
story_structure.resolution: The journey concludes with the blogger gaining a deeper, more grounded perspective on family, connection, and real life beyond the lens of a blog.
story_structure.introduction: An ambitious wanna-be blogger sets out on an adventurous summer road trip accompanied by his loyal dog, his step-dad, and a small film crew to document the vibrant psychedelic concert scene.
story_structure.risingAction: As the crew travels from one chaotic venue to another, escalating mishaps, emotional friction between family members, and the surreal realities of the festival circuit force the blogger to confront his motivations.
